sources: Torex XC6206 Series data sheet ETR0305_004b, via LCSC https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/221c990eb3a74b8a8233f22168ce0d59.pdf?productCode=C5446, read 2026-10-31; product.torexsemi.com refused the connection (proxy), so the current revision was not compared

pins: p. 2 pin configuration and pin assignment, SOT-23: 1 VSS, 2 VOUT, 3 VIN (VIN alone on the top side of the top view); the cached footprint has pads 1 and 2 on one side, pad 3 alone; the EasyEDA symbol of C5446 (edakit part import 2026-10-31) names 1 GND, 2 Vin, 3 Vout – names kept as in the symbol, roles and types from the data sheet (handbook 4.1, 4.4)

for comparison: UMW's XC6206 data sheet (C347376, March 2025, via LCSC, read 2026-10-31) numbers the SOT-23 pins 1 GND, 2 Input (the single pin on its side), 3 Output – the EasyEDA symbol of C5446 carries that naming, while its footprint has pad 3, not pad 2, as the single pad; on the Torex part the single pin is VIN = pin 3
vdd_max_v 7.0, VIN v_max_v 7.0: p. 3 absolute maximum input voltage; p_max_w 0.25: p. 3 power dissipation SOT-23 250 mW; t_min_c -40, t_max_c 85: p. 3 operating ambient temperature
vdd_op_min_v 1.8, vdd_op_max_v 6.0, vin_min_v 1.8: p. 4 input voltage 1.8 … 6.0 V
vout_v 3.3: P332 = 3.3 V, accuracy code 2 = ±2 % (p. 2 ordering information); table E-1 p. 5: 3.234 … 3.366 V at IOUT 30 mA
i_out_max_a 0.2: table E-2 p. 5, maximum output current (min) 200 mA for 3.0–3.9 V outputs; p. 1 '200 mA (3.0 V type)'; the absolute maximum 500 mA (p. 3) is bounded by Pd / (VIN − VOUT)
dropout_v 0.68: table E-5 p. 5, Vdif2 at IOUT 100 mA, typ 250 mV, max 680 mV for 3.0–3.9 V outputs – the maximum entered, the ldo model takes one value; Vdif1 at 30 mA: 75 / 350 mV
iq_a 3e-06: p. 4 supply current IDD typ 1.0 µA, max 3.0 µA – the maximum entered

LDO choice for the library (2026-10-31, edakit part search and LCSC product data): XC6206P332MR-G by Torex is the only Basic Part among the low-quiescent 3.3 V candidates and has the largest JLCPCB stock (524 981 pcs; LCSC 160 825); compared: ME6211C33M5G-N C82942 (Extended, 597 pcs), HT7333-A C21583 (Holtek, Extended, 19 318 pcs), MCP1700-3302E/TO C511277 (TO-92, Extended, 318 pcs)
notes: Low-quiescent 3.3 V LDO (1 µA typ), 200 mA, input up to 6 V. Behaviour model ldo (pins vin, vout, gnd). The EasyEDA symbol of C5446 names pins 2 and 3 the other way round than the data sheet – the roles follow the data sheet. Library draft, group power.

2026-10-31: symbol_differs – the EasyEDA symbol swaps Vin and Vout against Torex's pin assignment (STRUCT.entry/declared)
open: the EasyEDA symbol of C5446 names pad 2 'Vin' and pad 3 'Vout' (UMW's pin numbering, where the single pin is 2), the Torex data sheet gives pad 2 VOUT and pad 3 VIN (the single pin) – a board wired by the symbol's names would feed the regulator backwards; the owner may want to confirm with a current Torex revision or a delivered part before the symbol is used
ETR0305_004b is an older revision; the current Torex revision could not be fetched
input and output capacitors: only the typical application's 1.0 µF ceramic; no minimum and no ESR window, so the needs carry no window
no θJA and no junction temperature limit in the data sheet (only Pd 250 mW for SOT-23): no LIM.t item
dropout_v is one number (680 mV max at 100 mA); at 30 mA the maximum is 350 mV
